external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and may connect partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: member phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone running the mobile app and storing its refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A member's browser used to sign in, approve consent, and return an authorization code.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization code flows, issues tokens, and serves the sign-in and consent pages.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app and used to read and write the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction, including the client that made each change.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: authorization code flow
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.
data_flows.data_description: authorization code, access token, and refresh token

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: client ID, client secret, authorization code, and tokens

data_flows.name: sign-in and consent
data_flows.description: The browser is used to sign in and approve the partner app's consent screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: disconnect partner app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app, causing its refresh token to be deleted from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app
data_flows.data_description: partner app refresh token and disconnection request

data_flows.name: request access token
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: read and write ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes each received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close member account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

data_flows.name: manage identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and manages member accounts, credentials, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: download signing key
data_flows.description: The rewards API downloads a public key from the authorization server when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's own cloud account, where the described platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones that are outside the organisation's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information, password hashes, tokens, authorization codes, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and points transactions associated with members.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because request headers may contain credentials and requests may contain personal information.
assumptions.basis: The store contains every request received by the rewards API, headers included.
